note_en: 一 … 就 … means "as soon as … then …": 一有空就想拿起手机 "the moment they have a free minute, they want to pick up their phone." Put 一 before the first verb and 就 before the second; both come after the subject (if any), so English "as soon as" at the start of the clause becomes two small words split across the sentence.
